div.div: Ongoing alignment: The Xt-EHR logical models are continuously reviewed and refined. Updates from Xt-EHR will be progressively incorporated into this implementation guide to maintain alignment with evolving EHDS specifications.

div.p: This page explains how the conceptual elements of the document body logical model are represented by the corresponding FHIR profiles used in this implementation guide.

ul.li: Mapping scope: A.2-A.3 K-request document body

zavaznaAnamnestickaDataSignificant medical historyrelatedCondition (CZ_ConditionCore)code; note.textComposition (KOrderCompositionCz).section[supportingInformation].entry.resolve()Represent structured historical and long-term conditions as CZ_ConditionCore. Reference the same Condition from ServiceRequest.supportingInfo when relevant to a particular service; use reasonReference for a direct indication.
vysledkyVysetreni Examination results related Composition (KOrderCompositionCz) section[supportingInformation].entry
Observation (CZ_MedicalTestResultCore). Examination results use general CZ Observations in the open part of the list. Record the test in code, the result in value[x] or component and comments in note; a textual summary may appear in the supportingInformation narrative.
vysledkyVysetreni Examination results related ServiceRequest (KOrderServiceRequestCz) supportingInfo Composition (KOrderCompositionCz).section[orderInformation].entry.resolve() Observation (CZ_MedicalTestResultCore). Reference the same Observations as Composition.section[supportingInformation].entry when relevant to this request. Repeat the reference, not the result resource.
diferencialniDiagnostickaRozvaha Differential diagnostic assessment equivalent Condition (CZ_ConditionCore) code.text; note.text Composition (KOrderCompositionCz).section[supportingInformation].entry.resolve() A differential diagnosis should have Condition.verificationStatus populated to express diagnostic certainty, for example differential. Record the rationale in Condition.note. For a particular service, reference the same Condition from ServiceRequest.supportingInfo; use reasonReference for the direct indication.
soucasnaLecbaCurrent treatmentrelatedMedicationStatement (CZ_MedicationStatementCore)medication[x]; dosage; note.textComposition (KOrderCompositionCz).section[supportingInformation].entry.resolve()
ServiceRequest (KOrderServiceRequestCz).supportingInfo.resolve()Map medication use to MedicationStatement and an administration event to MedicationAdministration. Preserve status, timing and dosage; medication use alone does not establish an administration event. Record a textual treatment summary in the supportingInformation narrative.
